 Entertainment DC Correspondent 10 Nov 2026 11:12 PM IST 10 Nov 2026 11:12 PM IST Amid the discussion, Aasif Khan shared his own perspective on the matter. He spoke about his experience of knowing Touqeer closely inside the Bigg Boss house
 x Aasif Khan and Qazi Touqeer in the frame. (Image/X) As Preferred
Source Recently, a clip of Qazi Touqeer created a buzz on social media. Following this, Bigg Boss 20 ex-contestant Aasif Khan came out in support of his fellow contestant. 
 The discussion started after people noticed Qazi's reaction to singer Jasmine Sandlas's song from Dhurandhar. The clip soon went viral, leading to various speculations on social media. 
 Amid the discussion, Aasif Khan shared his own perspective on the matter. He spoke about his experience of knowing Touqeer closely inside the Bigg Boss house. 
 Talking about Touqeer's emotions as an artist, Khan said that he could understand his feelings. However, he also appealed to people not to read too much into a moment that. According to him, it did not need any further interpretation. 
 Sharing a story on Instagram, Khan stated, "As an artist, I could relate to Qazi's emotions. In BB, I got to know him more closely." 
 Khan further mentioned that despite having several fights with Touqeer inside the house, he knows how much he loves his country. 
 He went on to explain that what he saw in the clip was simply one artist watching another artist perform on stage, which reminded him of his own journey and memories. 
 "We may have had a thousand fights between us, but I know how much he loves his country. He is a true Indian," he added. 
 He also mentioned, "In that reaction, I simply saw one artist watching another artist on stage, and it reminded him of his own journey and memories. Let's not give it a meaning it never had. Much love and power to you, Qazi Touqeer."
